More early engineering.

Commerce & integrations

Stores with business logic.

Magento tailoring and cart modules, multi-store commerce, wholesale commerce connected to accounting, directory platforms, and custom WordPress payment, coupon, quotation, and event plugins.

Custom applications

Beyond the storefront.

Government work-progress applications, legal software, video-conferencing applications, and database-backed portals alongside Linux and Windows hosting support.

Training & foundations

Build. Explain. Improve.

Technical training, QA, project coordination, troubleshooting, and early team leadership formed the foundation for my later platform and engineering ownership.
